result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor visual inconsistency.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off — both the image and the restaurant name are truncated, indicating a horizontal overflow or carousel layout issue where the last visible item is partially clipped without a clear visual affordance that it's scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the last partially visible card has a consistent peek amount (e.g., show ~20-30% of it) to signal scrollability, and make sure the restaurant name doesn't get hard-cut mid-word. Use an ellipsis or fade effect on the text instead.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is cut off mid-image at the bottom of the screen without any visual indication that the page continues, making it feel like an abrupt edge rather than a natural scroll continuation.
issues.suggestion: This is acceptable UX for scrollable content, but adding a subtle gradient fade or ensuring the cut happens at a more natural point (e.g., below the image label) would improve the visual polish.
